description: Travel disruption alerts near a location: active emergency signals around a latitude and longitude. Pass lat and lon (both required; the backend does not geocode place names here, so look up coordinates first); optional radius_miles, lookback_hours, signal_types (earthquake, weather_alert, wildfire, severe_storm, water_level) and water_site. Returns JSON with status (attention or clear), signals, and which sources answered or failed. Weather alerts cover the United States only. $0.01 via x402; invalid coordinates and a check where no source answers are refused without charge. Informational only: results can be incomplete, delayed, or incorrect; not emergency services and not a substitute for official instructions. This MCP never pays: it returns the live result if the backend answers, or the request URL and x402 payment metadata for a client that can pay.

lookback_hours.description: How far back to look for signals, in hours.

signal_types.description: Comma-separated: earthquake, weather_alert, wildfire, severe_storm, water_level.

trip_phase.description: Optional context, such as pre_trip or active travel.

water_site.description: Optional water gauge/site id for flood or river context.

name: check_trip_disruptions
